Package neupaths.api

Class LoadBalancedActivator

java.lang.Object
neupaths.api.Activator
neupaths.api.LoadBalancedActivator
public abstract class LoadBalancedActivator extends Activator
The base class for NeuPaths Load-Balanced activators. Load-Balanced activators register with a Load-Controller cell, which distributes the workload among the registered Load-Balanced cells.

  • Constructor Details

    • LoadBalancedActivator

      protected LoadBalancedActivator(String name, ReceptorSpec[] receptors, TransmitterSpec[] transmitters, LogicSubscriptionSpec[] subscriptions, String controllerName, String controllerDomain)
      Creates a new LoadBalancedActivator object.
      Parameters:
      name - This activator's name at runtime.
      receptors - The receptors this activator receives stimuli on.
      transmitters - The transmitters this activator emits stimuli on. If the transmitter array is empty (null or empty array), the activator does not emit stimuli.
      subscriptions - The subscriptions this activator advertises.
      controllerName - LoadControllerCell's name.
      controllerDomain - LoadControllerCell's domain.
